title: 第10章
content_zh: 第10章 谁教训谁寝室门被青青她们三个女生给关来起来，三个美女守在了外面，不许任何人进去，也没有驱散周围的男生，看样子，她们是想让所有人都见到楚子风呆会的惨样，也告诉所有人，得罪了自己姐妹，绝对不会有好下场的。寝室内楚子风与吴晓爱单独相处，可这种气氛任谁也受不了！吴晓爱的外表与她的脾气有着天壤之别，在这燕京大学里更是横着走，谁也不敢去得罪的，原因很简单，还不是因为吴晓爱有着一个不寻常的家庭背景。“楚子风，我现在给你两条路。”看着吴哓爱那恶狠狠的眼神，让楚子风猛然间想起《红楼梦》中的刘姥姥，跟《还珠格格》里面的容嬷嬷，这丫头小小年纪就已经这样了，如果再大一点，她岂不是要杀人放火！当然，楚子风是不会跟一个女人动手的，在楚子风的心中坚信一点，那就是，“我们孤儿院的孩子都是很善良的”，但善良归善良，也不可能任人宰割呀。“没想到我还有选择的机会！美女，你且说说看，我有哪两条路可走？”楚子风脸上带着笑意，多一事不如少一事，自己是来读书的，并不是来招惹麻烦的！吴晓爱阴笑了一声，说道：“你可以自己从窗户跳下去，那样的话，昨天的事情我就当没发生过。”小姐，你说笑吧！楚子风是这个汗呀！虽说以自己现在的修为，别说是这寝室大楼，就算再高几倍跳下去也不是问题，可那样的话，不被人当成怪物抓到某某研究所去做科学研究才怪呢！“你还是说说第二条路吧，我想第一条路我是办不到了！”“第二条路很简单，你在学校门口跪上一天，那昨天的事情我也可以当没发生过。”“美女，你这简直是在强人所难吗！难道你不知道，男儿膝下有黄金吗，我楚子风跪天跪地，跪将我带大的人，其他人，其他事情，不好意思，我不跪。”“那就没办法了，今天就要你知道知道，‘痛’字怎么写。”吴晓爱一步步的朝楚子风*近，*的楚子风是别无选择，自己这么善良，难道真要自己出狠招吗。好吧，这可是你*我的，别怪我不给你留面子。“美女，我看这样吧。昨天的事情的确是我不对，我给你道歉怎么样？”“道歉？如果道歉有用的话，要流氓做什么！”这话听着怎么这么耳熟！“我的意思是说，我公开向你道歉，也有两个选择，第一，我在学校的公布栏上将昨天的事情公布出来，说明是我楚子风在论坛上搞了鬼，让你吴大美女拿了个第三；第二个选择，我这就出去，当这外面所有同学的面向你道歉，将昨天我入侵学校电脑系统的经过一字不漏的说出来。”要知道，昨天的事情可是吴晓爱作弊在先，这件事除了楚子风他们寝室的人之外，其他人是不知道的，如果楚子风将这件事说出去，那到时全校的人就不会去在乎楚子风的行为了，而是会说吴晓爱原来都是靠着作弊拿下这两年燕京大学校花榜前三名的。吴晓爱可不是傻瓜，自然知道如果楚子风那样做的话会对自己有什么影响，到时自己将会被鄙视，在学校的威信将顿时无存！“不行，你不能那样做，不然……”“昨天的事情是我不对，我们孤儿院从小就教导我们，犯了错就一定要认错，我这就出去，当着所有同学的面将昨天我的不对说出来，然后再公开向你吴大美女道歉。”说完，楚子风就要朝寝室门口走去，可吴晓爱却一把拉住了楚子风，急道：“你，你不能那样做！”“要的，要的，一定要的，犯了错就一定要认的。”“楚子风，你到底想怎么样？”“我不想怎么样呀，我就是怕你让我从这跳下去，也怕了你让我跪在学校门口，跟这两件事相比起来，我觉得还是要公开向你道歉比较好。”吴晓爱急了，彻底急了，她没想到事情会发展成这样，自己是来找楚子风算账的，之前一口恶气也势必要楚子风这个新生好看，没想到，自己反倒被楚子风给威胁住了！“那昨天的事情我当没发生过可以了吧！”“那怎么行，我这个人向来正直，发生过的事情就是发生了，怎么能当没发生过呢，那样的话，你吴大美女哪有面子呀！”“这，这面子我不要了，你千万不要把昨天的事情说出去！”“呃，这个嘛！让我考虑一下先！”吴晓爱很是不爽的瞪着楚子风，心道：“你个该死的混蛋，居然敢威胁本小姐，你给本小姐等着，有你好果子吃的时候。”“那昨天的事就当没发生过，我们谁也不欠谁的。”说完，吴晓爱就要离开，也已经将门打了开来！在寝室外，所有学生都在等着看好戏，就连齐白三人也在外面，可他们却进不了寝室。“喂，吴大美女，这件事……”楚子风从寝室内追了出来，这话还未说完，吴晓爱立刻一手将楚子风的嘴给蒙住了，这一幕，使的寝室外所有学生都吓了一跳。开什么玩笑，吴大美女居然用手蒙着一个新生的嘴，他们什么关系呀？怎么看上去如此暧昧！“楚子风，算我求你了好不好，千万别乱说话！”吴晓爱轻声道，使的青青他们三个女生都纳闷，刚才在寝室里到底发生了什么事？为什么吴晓爱跟变了个人似的。齐白三人傻眼的看着楚子风，之后都伸出了大拇指！老四，你够鸟的，这才到大学三天的时间，就被你搞定了一个大美女！天呐，这什么世道，想我齐白可是风度翩翩，家财万贯，怎么美女就没看上我呢！楚子风将吴晓爱的手拉开，说道：“吴大美女，这件事……”“哈哈，各位，其实我跟楚子风是老朋友了，知道他也进入了我们燕大，所以来看看他，没别的什么事，大家散了吧！”吴晓爱的态度一变，居然还说跟楚子风是朋友，还是老朋友！想她吴大美女在燕大这三年，从没跟男生发生过任何的交际，就连那些出身豪门的公子哥也不正眼去看，没想到今天居然主动来找楚子风，还说楚子风是她的老朋友，老天爷呀，你啥时候能公平一点！楚子风很晕，这都什么跟什么呀，你吴大美女不是来教训我的吗，可现在，是谁教训了谁！“好了，子风，你好好学习，天天向上吧，以后有什么事可以直接来找我，我们姐妹还有事，就先走了。”这又出乎所有人意料，吴晓爱居然帮楚子风整理了一下衣服，看似很亲密的样子，可暗地里，吴晓爱却狠狠又轻声道：“你最好给我放聪明一点，不该说的话不要乱说，否则对你没任何的好处。”丢下一句吓死人不偿命的话，吴晓爱拉着青青她们三个离开了男寝室，周围所有的学生也是一脸嫉妒的散去了。PS：听说今天我过生日，哈哈，提前更新四章，也请大家收藏一个，砸点票票过来吧！
content_en: Chapter 10 Who Teaches Who? Qingqing and the other three girls locked the door of the dormitory. The three beauties stood guard outside and did not allow anyone to enter. They did not disperse the boys around. It seemed that they wanted everyone to see the miserable state of Chu Zifeng's stay. They also told everyone that they would never end well if they offended their sisters. Chu Zifeng and Wu Xiaoai were alone in the dormitory, but no one could stand this atmosphere! There is a huge difference between Wu Xiaoai's appearance and her temper. She walks sideways in Yanjing University and no one dares to offend her. The reason is very simple. It is not because Wu Xiaoai has an unusual family background. "Chu Zifeng, I'll give you two ways now." Looking at Wu Kuai'ai's vicious eyes, Chu Zifeng suddenly remembered Grandma Liu in "A Dream of Red Mansions" and Grandma Rong in "Huan Zhu Ge Ge". This girl has been like this at a young age. If she were older, wouldn't she want to kill people and set fire to them! Of course, Chu Zifeng would not do anything to a woman. Chu Zifeng firmly believed in one thing, that is, "the children in our orphanage are all very kind." But kindness is kindness, and it is impossible to let others take advantage of it. "I didn't expect that I still have a choice! Beauty, please tell me, which two paths do I have?" Chu Zifeng had a smile on his face. It would be better to do less than to do more. He came here to study, not to cause trouble! Wu Xiaoai laughed darkly and said, "You can jump out of the window by yourself. In that case, I will pretend that what happened yesterday never happened." Miss, you are joking! Chu Zifeng is so sweaty! Although with my current level of cultivation, let alone this dormitory building, it would not be a problem even if I jumped several times higher, but in that case, it would be weird if I wasn't treated as a monster and caught in a certain research institute for scientific research! "You should talk about the second way. I don't think I can do the first way!" "The second way is very simple. If you kneel at the school gate for a day, then I can pretend that what happened yesterday never happened." "Beauty, are you trying to force others to do something difficult! Don't you know that there is gold under the man's knees? I, Chu Zifeng, kneel down Kneel to the ground, kneel to the people who brought me up, other people, other things, I'm sorry, I won't kneel. ""Then there is no other way, today I want you to know how to write the word "pain"." Wu Xiaoai stepped closer to Chu Zifeng, and Chu Zifeng had no choice. He was so kind, did he really want to take a cruel move on his own. Well, this is yours and mine, don't blame me for not saving face for you. "Beauty, let me see it this way. What happened yesterday was indeed my fault, how about I apologize to you?" "Apologise? If an apology is useful, what do you want a gangster to do!" Why does this sound so familiar! "What I mean is that I publicly apologize to you. There are two options. First, I will announce what happened yesterday on the school bulletin board, explaining that I, Chu Zifeng, caused trouble on the forum and let you, Miss Wu, take the third place. The second option is that I will go out and apologize to you in front of all the classmates outside, telling you exactly what happened yesterday when I invaded the school computer system. "You must know that Wu Xiaoai cheated first about what happened yesterday, and no one except Chu Zifeng and his dormitory knew about it. If Chu Zifeng told this matter, then everyone in the school would not care about Chu Zifeng's behavior, but would say that Wu Xiaoai relied on cheating to win the top three spots in the Yanjing University flower list in the past two years. Wu Xiaoai is not a fool. She naturally knows what impact it will have on herself if Chu Zifeng does that. Then she will be despised and her prestige in the school will suddenly disappear! "No, you can't do that, otherwise..." "What happened yesterday was my fault. Our orphanage has taught us since we were young that we must admit our mistakes when we make them. I will go out right now and tell all my classmates what I did wrong yesterday, and then I will publicly apologize to you, Miss Wu." After saying that, Chu Zifeng was about to walk towards the door of the dormitory, but Wu Xiaoai grabbed Chu Zifeng and said urgently: "You, you can't do that!" "Yes, yes, you must, you must do it if you make a mistake. "I admit it." "Chu Zifeng, what do you want?" "I don't want to do anything. I am just afraid that you will let me jump from here, and I am afraid that you will make me kneel in front of the school. Compared with these two things, I think it is better to apologize to you publicly. Okay." Wu Xiaoai was anxious, completely anxious. She didn't expect that things would develop like this. She came to settle accounts with Chu Zifeng. Her previous bad breath was bound to make Chu Zifeng look good. Unexpectedly, she was threatened by Chu Zifeng! "Then I can pretend that what happened yesterday never happened!" "How can that be done? I have always been an upright person. Whatever happened happened, how can I pretend that it never happened? In that case, how can you, Miss Wu, have any face?" "Well, I don't want this face anymore. You must not tell anyone what happened yesterday!" "Uh, that's it! Let me think about it first!" Wu Xiaoai glared at Chu Zifeng in displeasure and thought: "You damn bastard, how dare you threaten me, please let me wait for you to enjoy." "Then just pretend that what happened yesterday didn't happen, and we don't owe anyone anything." After saying that, Wu Xiaoai was about to leave and opened the door! Outside the dormitory, all the students were waiting to watch the show. Even Qi Bai and the other three were outside, but they couldn't enter the dormitory. "Hey, Miss Wu, what's going on..." Chu Zifeng chased her out of the dormitory. Before she could finish her words, Wu Xiaoai immediately covered Chu Zifeng's mouth with one hand. This scene shocked all the students outside the dormitory. Are you kidding me? Beauty Wu actually covered a new student's mouth with her hand. What's their relationship? Why do you look so warm?
